blocks.en: Master the core principles of sterile product manufacturing facility design: Quality by Design (QbD), the risk-based approach, and how CQAs and CPPs drive facility design decisions

blocks.zh: Section Contents / 本章目錄
blocks.en: Section Contents

blocks.zh: 1.1 Background 1.1 背景
blocks.en: 1.1 Background

blocks.zh: 教學解析
blocks.en: Teaching Notes

blocks.zh: 核心概念：ISPE Baseline Guide 的定位
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Positioning of the ISPE Baseline Guide

blocks.zh: ISPE Baseline Guide (基準指南) 是工程導向的技術文件，與 PDA Technical Report (科學導向) 的差異在於：
blocks.en: The ISPE Baseline Guide is an engineering-oriented technical document. It differs from the PDA Technical Reports (science-oriented) as follows:

blocks.zh: ISPE：聚焦設施設計 (Facility Design)、建造、調試與確認 (C&Q)
blocks.en: ISPE: focuses on facility design, construction, commissioning and qualification (C&Q)

blocks.zh: PDA：聚焦製程科學、微生物學、無菌保證
blocks.en: PDA: focuses on process science, microbiology and sterility assurance

blocks.zh: 兩者互補，在實務中經常交叉引用。
blocks.en: The two are complementary and are frequently cross-referenced in practice.

blocks.zh: 重要時間軸提醒
blocks.en: Important Timeline Reminder

blocks.zh: 本指南出版於 2018 年，引用的 EU GMP Annex 1 (GMP 附件一) 版本為 2008 年版。然而，EU GMP Annex 1 已於 2022 年完成重大修訂（2023 年 8 月正式生效），引入了 Contamination Control Strategy (CCS, 污染控制策略) 等全新要求。
blocks.en: This guide was published in 2018 and cites the 2008 version of EU GMP Annex 1. However, EU GMP Annex 1 underwent a major revision completed in 2022 (formally in effect from August 2023), introducing entirely new requirements such as the Contamination Control Strategy (CCS).

blocks.zh: 閱讀本指南時，應同步參照 2022 版 Annex 1 的更新要求。
blocks.en: When reading this guide, also refer to the updated requirements of the 2022 version of Annex 1.

blocks.zh: 比喻：為什麼需要 Baseline Guide？
blocks.en: Analogy: Why Do We Need a Baseline Guide?

blocks.zh: 想像你要蓋一間無塵室工廠：法規告訴你「需要達到 ISO 5 等級」，但沒告訴你牆壁用什麼材質、空調怎麼設計、走道寬度多少。ISPE Baseline Guide 就像「建築師的參考手冊」，將法規要求轉化為可執行的工程設計方案。
blocks.en: Imagine you are building a cleanroom plant. The regulation tells you "you need to achieve ISO 5", but it does not tell you what material to use for the walls, how to design the air handling, or how wide the corridors should be. The ISPE Baseline Guide is like an "architect's reference manual" that translates regulatory requirements into executable engineering design solutions.

blocks.zh: 關鍵法規參考文件
blocks.en: Key Regulatory Reference Documents

blocks.zh: FDA Aseptic Guidance (2004) — 美國 FDA 無菌製程指引
blocks.en: FDA Aseptic Guidance (2004) — the US FDA guidance on aseptic processing

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 (GMP 附件一) — 歐盟無菌製造附件
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 — the EU annex on the manufacture of sterile medicinal products

blocks.zh: ISO 14644 (潔淨室標準) — 取代美國舊制 Federal Standard 209E
blocks.en: ISO 14644 (cleanroom standard) — replaces the old US Federal Standard 209E

blocks.zh: ISO 13408 (無菌製程標準) — Aseptic Processing (無菌製程) 要求
blocks.en: ISO 13408 (aseptic processing standard) — requirements for aseptic processing

blocks.zh: 1.2 Scope and Purpose of This Guide 1.2 本指南範圍與目的
blocks.en: 1.2 Scope and Purpose of This Guide

blocks.zh: 核心概念：本指南的法律地位
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Legal Status of This Guide

blocks.zh: ISPE Baseline Guide 不是法規，也不是標準。它是業界公認的「最佳工程實務」參考文件。在法規稽核中，稽核員可能引用 ISPE Guide 來評估設施設計是否符合當前業界標準，但企業沒有法律義務完全遵守。
blocks.en: The ISPE Baseline Guide is neither a regulation nor a standard. It is an industry-recognized reference document on "best engineering practice". In regulatory inspections, inspectors may cite the ISPE Guide to assess whether a facility design meets current industry standards, but companies are under no legal obligation to follow it in full.

blocks.zh: 然而，若設計明顯偏離 Baseline Guide 的建議，企業需準備充分的科學與工程依據來支持其設計選擇。
blocks.en: However, if a design deviates significantly from the recommendations of the Baseline Guide, the company must be prepared with sufficient scientific and engineering justification to support its design choices.

blocks.zh: 適用範圍：兩大製造路線
blocks.en: Scope: Two Manufacturing Routes

blocks.zh: 本指南涵蓋兩種無菌產品製造設施 (Sterile Product Manufacturing Facility, 無菌產品製造設施)：
blocks.en: This guide covers two types of sterile product manufacturing facility:

blocks.zh: Aseptic Processing (無菌製程)：產品成分分別滅菌後，在無菌環境下組合充填。設施要求最高（需 ISO 5/Grade A 環境）。
blocks.en: Aseptic Processing: the product components are sterilized separately, then combined and filled in a sterile environment. This carries the highest facility requirements (an ISO 5/Grade A environment is required).

blocks.zh: Terminal Sterilization (終端滅菌)：產品充填封裝後，以最終包裝形式進行滅菌。設施要求相對較低，但仍需控制 bioburden。
blocks.en: Terminal Sterilization: the product is filled and sealed, then sterilized in its final container. Facility requirements are comparatively lower, but bioburden must still be controlled.

blocks.zh: 比喻：無菌製程 vs 終端滅菌
blocks.en: Analogy: Aseptic Processing vs Terminal Sterilization

blocks.zh: 無菌製程 (Aseptic Processing) 就像在手術室裡做手術 — 全程都要保持無菌狀態，任何一個環節的污染都可能導致失敗。終端滅菌 (Terminal Sterilization) 則像是把食物罐裝後再高溫殺菌 — 充填過程中容許較低的控制等級，因為最後會整體滅菌。
blocks.en: Aseptic processing is like performing surgery in an operating room — sterility must be maintained throughout, and contamination at any single step can lead to failure. Terminal sterilization is like canning food and then heat-sterilizing it — a lower level of control is tolerated during filling because the whole product is sterilized at the end.

blocks.zh: 工程視角 vs 科學視角
blocks.en: Engineering Perspective vs Scientific Perspective

blocks.zh: 本指南明確指出其焦點是設施工程議題。涉及微生物學或操作層面的內容僅為讓工程師了解其對設計的影響。若需深入的微生物或品質保證知識，應參考：
blocks.en: The guide states clearly that its focus is on facility engineering issues. Microbiological or operational content is included only so that engineers understand its impact on design. For in-depth microbiology or quality assurance knowledge, refer to:

blocks.zh: PDA TR13：環境監測 (Environmental Monitoring)
blocks.en: PDA TR13: Environmental Monitoring

blocks.zh: PDA TR22：製程模擬 (Process Simulation)
blocks.en: PDA TR22: Process Simulation

blocks.zh: PDA TR90：污染控制策略 (CCS)
blocks.en: PDA TR90: Contamination Control Strategy (CCS)

blocks.zh: ICH Q-Trio 與設施設計
blocks.en: The ICH Q-Trio and Facility Design

blocks.zh: ICH Q8：Pharmaceutical Development — Quality by Design (QbD, 品質源於設計) 的基礎
blocks.en: ICH Q8: Pharmaceutical Development — the foundation of Quality by Design (QbD)

blocks.zh: ICH Q9：Quality Risk Management — 風險評估工具（FMEA、FTA 等）
blocks.en: ICH Q9: Quality Risk Management — risk assessment tools (FMEA, FTA, etc.)

blocks.zh: ICH Q10：Pharmaceutical Quality Systems — 品質體系的持續改善框架
blocks.en: ICH Q10: Pharmaceutical Quality System — the framework for continual improvement of the quality system

blocks.zh: 這三份文件構成了「以科學與風險為基礎」的品質管理架構，直接影響設施設計決策。
blocks.en: These three documents form the science- and risk-based quality management framework that directly influences facility design decisions.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Application

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO（委託開發暨製造組織），本指南的適用範圍特別重要：
blocks.en: For a CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organization), the scope of this guide is especially important:

blocks.zh: CDMO 的設施需同時滿足多個客戶的產品需求，設計時需考慮最大公約數
blocks.en: A CDMO facility must meet the product requirements of multiple clients at the same time, so the design must consider the lowest common denominator

blocks.zh: 客戶的產品可能涵蓋 Aseptic Processing 與 Terminal Sterilization，設施需具備彈性
blocks.en: Client products may include both aseptic processing and terminal sterilization, so the facility needs flexibility

blocks.zh: 本指南明確指出適用於「conventional chemistry 或 biopharmaceutical processing」的 API — 涵蓋化學藥與生物製劑，與 CDMO 的多元產品組合一致
blocks.en: The guide explicitly states that it applies to APIs made by "conventional chemistry or biopharmaceutical processing" — covering both chemical drugs and biologics, consistent with a CDMO's diverse product portfolio

blocks.zh: 1.3 Key Features of This Guide 1.3 本指南主要特點
blocks.en: 1.3 Key Features of This Guide

blocks.zh: 核心概念：CQA 與 CPP 驅動設施設計
blocks.en: Core Concept: CQAs and CPPs Drive Facility Design

blocks.zh: 本指南的核心設計哲學是：產品的品質屬性 (CQA) 決定製程參數 (CPP)，製程參數決定設施規格。這是 Quality by Design (QbD, 品質源於設計) 在設施工程上的體現。
blocks.en: The core design philosophy of this guide is: the product's quality attributes (CQAs) determine the process parameters (CPPs), and the process parameters determine the facility specifications. This is how Quality by Design (QbD) is embodied in facility engineering.

blocks.zh: Critical Quality Attributes (CQA, 關鍵品質屬性)：例如無菌性、微粒數、內毒素水平
blocks.en: Critical Quality Attributes (CQAs): for example sterility, particle counts and endotoxin level

blocks.zh: Critical Process Parameters (CPP, 關鍵製程參數)：例如充填速度、環境溫濕度、壓差
blocks.en: Critical Process Parameters (CPPs): for example fill speed, ambient temperature and humidity, and differential pressure

blocks.zh: 設施設計：HVAC 規格、潔淨室分級、屏障技術選擇
blocks.en: Facility design: HVAC specifications, cleanroom classification and the choice of barrier technology

blocks.zh: 設施設計決策鏈
blocks.en: Facility Design Decision Chain

blocks.zh:
產品 CQA (無菌性、微粒)
    ↓ 定義
製程 CPP (充填環境、壓差、換氣次數)
    ↓ 驅動
設施規格 (潔淨室等級、HVAC、屏障技術)
    ↓ 影響
投資與營運成本
blocks.en:
Product CQAs (sterility, particles)
    ↓ define
Process CPPs (filling environment, differential pressure, air change rate)
    ↓ drive
Facility specifications (cleanroom grade, HVAC, barrier technology)
    ↓ affect
Investment and operating cost

blocks.zh: 最重要的一句話
blocks.en: The Most Important Sentence

blocks.zh: 人員是無菌製程中最大的污染來源 — 這個觀念是所有屏障技術（RABS、Isolator）發展的根本驅動力。整個設施設計的核心目標之一，就是將人員與產品之間的接觸介面最小化。
blocks.en: Personnel are the greatest source of contamination in aseptic processing — this idea is the fundamental driver behind the development of all barrier technologies (RABS, isolators). One of the core goals of the entire facility design is to minimize the contact interface between personnel and product.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Open vs Closed Processing
blocks.en: Analogy: Open vs Closed Processing

blocks.zh: Open Processing（開放式製程）：產品暴露在環境中，就像在開放式廚房裡做菜 — 環境品質直接影響食物品質。需要 ISO 5/Grade A 環境。
blocks.en: Open processing: the product is exposed to the environment, like cooking in an open kitchen — environmental quality directly affects food quality. An ISO 5/Grade A environment is required.

blocks.zh: Closed Processing（封閉式製程）：產品在密封系統中流動，就像管路輸送 — 週圍環境的要求可以降低。
blocks.en: Closed processing: the product flows within a sealed system, like piped transfer — requirements for the surrounding environment can be lower.

blocks.zh: In Operation（運行狀態）：設備運轉、人員在場、正常生產中。這是最嚴格的測試條件，也是法規真正關注的狀態。
blocks.en: In operation: equipment running, personnel present, normal production under way. This is the most stringent test condition and the state the regulations are truly concerned with.

blocks.zh: At Rest（靜態）：設備已安裝完成但未運轉、無人員在場。主要用作系統性能基準 (benchmark)。
blocks.en: At rest: equipment installed but not running, no personnel present. Mainly used as a benchmark of system performance.

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 對兩種狀態都有微粒限值要求；FDA 指引主要關注 in operation。第三版指南致力於統一全球命名法。
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 sets particle limits for both states; the FDA guidance focuses mainly on in operation. The third edition of the guide strives to harmonize nomenclature globally.

blocks.zh: HVAC 設計的五大空氣品質控制手段
blocks.en: Five Means of Air Quality Control in HVAC Design

blocks.zh: Air Filtration（空氣過濾）：HEPA 濾網（H14, 99.995%）
blocks.en: Air filtration: HEPA filters (H14, 99.995%)

blocks.zh: Airflow Uniformity（氣流均勻性）：單向流 (unidirectional airflow) 於關鍵區域
blocks.en: Airflow uniformity: unidirectional airflow in critical areas

blocks.zh: Cleanliness Cascades（潔淨度層級）：從高潔淨區到低潔淨區的梯度設計
blocks.en: Cleanliness cascades: a gradient design from higher-cleanliness areas to lower-cleanliness areas

blocks.zh: Pressure Differentials（壓差）：正壓保護高潔淨區
blocks.en: Pressure differentials: positive pressure protects higher-cleanliness areas

blocks.zh: Bio-contamination Dilution（生物污染稀釋）：足夠的換氣次數
blocks.en: Bio-contamination dilution: sufficient air change rates

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Reflection Exercises

blocks.zh: 如果你的產品可以承受終端滅菌（Terminal Sterilization），但客戶堅持使用無菌製程（Aseptic Processing），你會如何建議？這對設施設計有什麼影響？
blocks.en: If your product can withstand terminal sterilization but the client insists on aseptic processing, how would you advise them? What impact does this have on facility design?

blocks.zh: 在設計新的充填線時，選擇 RABS 還是 Isolator？列出三個關鍵考量因素。
blocks.en: When designing a new filling line, do you choose RABS or an isolator? List three key considerations.

blocks.zh: Good Engineering Practice (GEP) 與 GMP 的關係是什麼？為什麼本指南特別強調 GEP？
blocks.en: What is the relationship between Good Engineering Practice (GEP) and GMP? Why does this guide place particular emphasis on GEP?

blocks.zh: 1.4 Terminology Used in This Guide 1.4 本指南使用的術語
blocks.en: 1.4 Terminology Used in This Guide

blocks.zh: GMP vs cGMP — 有什麼差別？
blocks.en: GMP vs cGMP — What Is the Difference?

blocks.zh: cGMP（current Good Manufacturing Practice）是美國 FDA 使用的術語，「c」代表「current（現行）」，強調法規要求是動態演進的，企業必須跟上最新的技術水準。
blocks.en: cGMP (current Good Manufacturing Practice) is the term used by the US FDA. The "c" stands for "current", emphasizing that regulatory requirements evolve and companies must keep pace with the latest technological standards.

blocks.zh: GMP 是歐盟、日本、PIC/S 等地區使用的術語。
blocks.en: GMP is the term used in the EU, Japan, PIC/S and elsewhere.

blocks.zh: 本指南統一使用 GMP，但當涉及美國法規時，應理解為 cGMP。實務上兩者意涵相同。
blocks.en: This guide uses GMP throughout, but where US regulations are involved it should be understood as cGMP. In practice the two mean the same thing.

blocks.zh: 環境分級命名法的混亂
blocks.en: Confusion Over Environmental Classification Nomenclature

blocks.zh: 在無菌製造領域，同一個潔淨度等級有多種命名：
blocks.en: In sterile manufacturing, the same cleanliness level has several names:

blocks.zh: 第三版指南採用「雙重標示法」（如 ISO 5/Grade A）來統一命名，詳見 Chapter 2。
blocks.en: The third edition of the guide adopts a "dual designation" (such as ISO 5/Grade A) to unify the nomenclature; see Chapter 2 for details.

blocks.zh: 1.5 Changes Since the Previous Edition of This Guide 1.5 與前版的變更
blocks.en: 1.5 Changes Since the Previous Edition of This Guide

blocks.zh: 第三版四大關鍵變更
blocks.en: Four Key Changes in the Third Edition

blocks.zh: 全球化設計方法：不再分開討論美國與歐盟的設施設計，而是提供統一的全球化方案，包含 RABS、Isolator、BFS 三種技術的推薦佈局。
blocks.en: Globalized design approach: facility design for the US and the EU is no longer discussed separately; instead a unified global approach is provided, including recommended layouts for three technologies: RABS, isolators and BFS.

blocks.zh: 環境分級統一命名：廢除 ISPE 自訂分級（如 Grade 5），改用雙重標示法（ISO 5/Grade A）。同時取消 CNC 和 UC 的正式定義。
blocks.en: Unified environmental classification nomenclature: ISPE's own custom grades (such as Grade 5) are abolished in favor of the dual designation (ISO 5/Grade A). The formal definitions of CNC and UC are also removed.

blocks.zh: LP/GAAS 概念新增：Local Protection/Grade A Air Supply — 在較低等級區域中提供局部 Grade A 空氣供應，適用於特定高風險操作點。
blocks.en: New LP/GAAS concept: Local Protection/Grade A Air Supply — providing a local Grade A air supply within lower-grade areas, suitable for specific high-risk operation points.

blocks.zh: 微粒監測指引：新增實務性的微粒監測操作指引。
blocks.en: Particle monitoring guidance: new practical operational guidance on particle monitoring is added.

blocks.zh: 比喻：雙重標示法為什麼重要？
blocks.en: Analogy: Why Is the Dual Designation Important?

blocks.zh: 想像你是一家跨國 CDMO，同時供貨給美國和歐洲客戶。美國客戶說「我要 ISO 5」，歐洲客戶說「我要 Grade A」— 其實他們要的是同一件事。雙重標示法（ISO 5/Grade A）消除了這種溝通混亂，讓全球化設施可以「一次設計、兩邊合規」。
blocks.en: Imagine you are a multinational CDMO supplying both US and European clients. The US client says "I want ISO 5" and the European client says "I want Grade A" — in fact they are asking for the same thing. The dual designation (ISO 5/Grade A) removes this communication confusion and lets a global facility be "designed once, compliant on both sides".

blocks.zh: LP/GAAS：局部保護的新概念
blocks.en: LP/GAAS: The New Concept of Local Protection

blocks.zh: Local Protection/Grade A Air Supply (LP/GAAS) 是指在較低等級的環境（如 ISO 7/Grade B）中，針對特定操作點提供 Grade A 等級的局部空氣保護。
blocks.en: Local Protection/Grade A Air Supply (LP/GAAS) means providing Grade A local air protection at a specific operation point within a lower-grade environment (such as ISO 7/Grade B).

blocks.zh: 應用場景舉例：
blocks.en: Examples of application:

blocks.zh: 在 Grade B 環境中的滅菌後物料轉運口
blocks.en: Post-sterilization material transfer port in a Grade B environment

blocks.zh: 在 Grade C/D 環境中的取樣操作點
blocks.en: Sampling points in a Grade C/D environment

blocks.zh: 需要局部高潔淨度但不需要整個房間升級的操作
blocks.en: Operations that need local high cleanliness but do not justify upgrading the entire room

blocks.zh: 對於同時供應美國市場與歐盟市場的 CDMO 而言，第三版的全球化設計方法尤其重要：
blocks.en: For a CDMO supplying both the US and EU markets, the third edition's global design approach is especially important:

blocks.zh: 採用雙重標示法可避免客戶稽核時的命名爭議
blocks.en: Using the dual designation avoids nomenclature disputes during client audits

blocks.zh: 全球化設施佈局設計一次性滿足 FDA 與 EMA 的要求
blocks.en: A global facility layout design meets FDA and EMA requirements in one go

blocks.zh: 若僅供應單一市場，可適度簡化設計以降低成本（如本節 Note 所述）
blocks.en: If only a single market is supplied, the design can be reasonably simplified to reduce cost (as described in the Note in this section)

blocks.zh: 1.6 Considerations for Legacy Facilities 1.6 既有設施之考量
blocks.en: 1.6 Considerations for Legacy Facilities

blocks.zh: Legacy Facility（既有設施）的挑戰
blocks.en: The Challenge of Legacy Facilities

blocks.zh: 本指南雖然以新建設施為主要對象，但明確指出也適用於既有設施的翻新改造。這在實務中非常重要，因為：
blocks.en: Although this guide mainly addresses new facilities, it explicitly states that it also applies to the renovation of existing facilities. This is very important in practice because:

blocks.zh: 大多數製藥設施都是在數十年前建造的，並非全新建設
blocks.en: Most pharmaceutical facilities were built decades ago rather than being newly constructed

blocks.zh: 翻新既有設施需在「維持生產」和「符合新法規」之間取得平衡
blocks.en: Renovating an existing facility requires balancing "maintaining production" against "complying with new regulations"

blocks.zh: 對已驗證的系統 (validated legacy systems) 進行變更需通過嚴謹的變更管制 (Change Control) 流程
blocks.en: Changes to validated legacy systems must go through a rigorous Change Control process

blocks.zh: 比喻：老房子改造
blocks.en: Analogy: Renovating an Old House

blocks.zh: 翻新既有製藥設施就像改造一棟住人的老房子 — 你不能讓住戶搬出去再施工（因為要維持生產），你必須一邊住人一邊改建，而且每改一個地方都要確認不影響水電和結構安全（即驗證狀態）。
blocks.en: Renovating an existing pharmaceutical facility is like remodeling an old house while people live in it — you cannot ask the residents to move out during construction (because production must continue), so you must rebuild while occupied, and for every change you must confirm that plumbing, electrics and structural safety (that is, the validated state) are not affected.

blocks.zh: 實務建議：漸進式升級策略
blocks.en: Practical Advice: A Phased Upgrade Strategy

blocks.zh: 對於既有設施，建議採取風險導向的漸進式升級：
blocks.en: For existing facilities, a risk-based phased upgrade is recommended:

blocks.zh: 先進行 Gap Analysis（差距分析）：對照本指南與 2022 版 Annex 1，找出現有設施的差距
blocks.en: Start with a gap analysis: compare the existing facility against this guide and the 2022 version of Annex 1 to identify gaps

blocks.zh: 以風險評估排定優先順序：優先處理直接影響產品無菌性的項目
blocks.en: Prioritize by risk assessment: address items that directly affect product sterility first

blocks.zh: 分階段實施：每次變更都經過驗證，不要一次大規模改造
blocks.en: Implement in phases: validate each change, and do not carry out one large-scale renovation

blocks.zh: 參考 ISPE GAMP Good Practice Guide: The Validation of Legacy Systems
blocks.en: Refer to the ISPE GAMP Good Practice Guide: The Validation of Legacy Systems

blocks.zh: CDMO 的設施翻新面臨獨特挑戰：
blocks.en: Facility renovation poses unique challenges for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 設施改造期間需維持對現有客戶的供貨承諾
blocks.en: Supply commitments to existing clients must be maintained during the renovation

blocks.zh: 新增產線（如從 conventional cleanroom 升級至 RABS 或 Isolator）需重新驗證整個系統
blocks.en: A new line (for example, upgrading from a conventional cleanroom to RABS or an isolator) requires revalidation of the entire system

blocks.zh: 每次設施變更都需通知所有使用該設施的客戶（regulatory notification）
blocks.en: Every facility change must be notified to all clients using the facility (regulatory notification)

blocks.zh: 建議建立「設施主計畫 (Facility Master Plan)」，將長期升級路線圖與客戶需求對齊
blocks.en: It is advisable to establish a Facility Master Plan that aligns the long-term upgrade roadmap with client needs

blocks.zh: Section Summary / 本章總結
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 重點回顧
blocks.en: Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: 五個必記要點
blocks.en: Five Points to Remember

blocks.zh: ISPE = 工程導向：與 PDA（科學導向）互補，專注於設施設計、建造、調試與確認
blocks.en: ISPE = engineering-oriented: complementary to PDA (science-oriented), focusing on facility design, construction, commissioning and qualification

blocks.zh: CQA → CPP → 設施規格：品質源於設計 (QbD) 的設施工程應用
blocks.en: CQA → CPP → facility specifications: the application of Quality by Design (QbD) to facility engineering

blocks.zh: 人員是最大污染源：所有屏障技術的發展都源於此核心認知
blocks.en: Personnel are the greatest source of contamination: the development of all barrier technologies stems from this core recognition

blocks.zh: 雙重標示法：ISO 5/Grade A 統一全球命名，消除跨區域溝通障礙
blocks.en: Dual designation: ISO 5/Grade A unifies global nomenclature and removes cross-regional communication barriers

blocks.zh: 2022 Annex 1 更新：本指南（2018）出版後，EU GMP Annex 1 已於 2022 年完成重大修訂，閱讀時需同步參照最新版本
blocks.en: 2022 Annex 1 update: after this guide (2018) was published, EU GMP Annex 1 underwent a major revision completed in 2022; read it alongside the latest version
